messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a phased canary for auth-service v3 today. @sam can you be primary deployer? target window 16:00-19:00 PT.

sam: Yep I can take it. What's the cohort split and smoke checklist?

maya: High level ramp:```
T+0: 0.1% (sanity)
T+20m: 1%
T+50m: 5%
T+120m: 25%
T+4h: 75%
T+6h: 100%
```
Cohorts: small internal set (canary-bucket-a), then US-prod low-traffic, then EU, then global. Flag key: `authv3.rollout` (gradual).

indra: I added the cohort mappings to the runbook. Smoke checks: auth latency P50 < 120ms, error-rate < 0.2% from baseline, and token issuance flow passes end-to-end test.

zoe: I'll own smoke scripts and synthetic checks. Posting quick run commands in case we need manual verification:```
# quick smoke flow
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer test" https://auth.internal/issue | jq .status
python tests/smoke/token_flow.py --target canary-bucket-a
```

sam: Cool. Release plan: I'll kick at 16:05 PT. Will wait for :thumbsup: from ops-oncall and leo for monitoring handoff.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-watch 15:45–19:30 PT. I'll wire up fast dashboards and set alerts: latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, backend queue depth. If p95 > 350ms or 5xx > 0.5% for 5m we trigger foldback.

leo: I'll take post-deploy log sampling and run the trace sampler for the first two ramps. If anything looks off ping me and I'll jump on debug.

maya: Rollback playbook (short):```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/auth-service auth-service=myregistry/auth-service:v2.14.3
# disable flag immediately
rbacctl feature disable authv3.rollout
# notify slack and ops-oncall
```
If rollback, we stop the ramp and backfill traffic to v2, then do a hotfix branch if needed.

sam: Understood. One ask — let's gate the 25% step on the canary-specific error budget metric (canary_error_budget > 80%). Can we add that to the automation?

release-bot: automation note: configured rollout stage hooks: pre-checks (smoke scripts), prometheus gating (canary_error_budget), post-metrics snapshot.

zoe: Added the pre-check hook. I'll run the smoke scripts manually for T+0 and T+20m, then we'll switch to automated gating for later steps.

maya: Final confirmations: @sam deployer, @zoe smoke owner, @ops-oncall monitoring, @leo tracing/logging. If no objections I'll start ramp in 20. :rocket:

indra: LGTM.

leo: LGTM — I'll standby.

ops-oncall: Ready. I'll post alerts channel if anything trips.

sam: Starting initial rollout at 16:05 PT. Will post updates at each ramp step.

maya: Thanks everyone — keep replies here for any anomalies so we have the timeline consolidated. :eyes:
